design_alternatives.choice: one exact per-job read/action rather than comma scontrol show or batch hold/release/requeue
design_alternatives.tradeoff: More bounded scheduler calls, but actual CLI compatibility and truthful partial audit results; explicit user operations only.

design_alternatives.choice: persisted comment-marker intent rather than immediate blind retry
design_alternatives.tradeoff: Additional small fsync writes off UI thread; delayed accounting may block until verified, preserving exactly-once safety.

design_alternatives.choice: refuse old generated wrappers; use existing fresh Run again workflow
design_alternatives.tradeoff: Requires one explicit navigation choice, prevents cross-attempt telemetry corruption and avoids inventing a second launch recipe implementation.

design_alternatives.choice: existing ResearchHub worker instead of another executor
design_alternatives.tradeoff: One explicit action may wait for prior background work; bounded concurrency and existing lifecycle/polling reused.
